precision_plan.policy: Compile once; full warmup and retained restart per tier; all attempts charged

hardware_control.enforcement: External wrapper required; worker checks expected inherited mask

compilation.data_policy: immutable constants; rebuild target when data changes
compilation.compilation_scope: model construction and public adapter compilation combined; existing disk caches may be reused

parity_timing_note: Runtime parity includes optional JAX/NumPyro imports and compilation; reported separately, included in invocation total. Production does not require those tools when prevalidated externally.

forecast.kind: fixed-origin multi-horizon conditional on supplied covariates; no holdout outcome updates
forecast.predictive_mcse_note: Includes one nested future-path and Student-t draw per posterior draw; endpoint MCSE combines posterior autocorrelation and nested Monte Carlo noise.
forecast.coverage_uncertainty: No iid binomial interval: horizons/groups share latent state; use independent datasets or origin blocks.
